prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Original exercise-library artwork with the visual simplicity of classic black-and-white fitness instruction drawings. Crisp clean black contours, white body fill, a few light gray equipment fills, very sparse anatomical contour lines, no hatching, no gradients, no realistic rendering, no shadows. SAME faceless athletic adult male mannequin with short simple hair silhouette, bare torso, plain black shorts, simple white trainers in both panels. White background. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, two equal panels with generous gap; same camera, scale and equipment in each. No text, no labels, no arrows, no decorative borders, no muscle-color overlay. Whole person and all functional equipment visible without cropping. Exactly two arms, two legs and two hands per figure. The two panels show distinct positions of ONE repetition. Machine joints and equipment must be mechanically plausible; no body intersects objects. This is a new original illustration, not a copy of an existing illustration.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; create new original artwork for the requested movement.
name: Chin-Up (underhand supinated pull-up)
camera: Front three-quarter view facing slightly right, showing athlete suspended from an overhead pull-up bar
equipment: Horizontal overhead pull-up bar
positionA: Left panel: Athlete hangs from overhead bar with underhand supinated grip (palms facing toward the face), shoulder-width apart, arms fully extended in a dead hang, chest lifted, ankles crossed behind.
positionB: Right panel: EXACT SAME pull-up bar. Athlete pulls body vertically until chin is cleared above the bar, driving elbows down and back close to ribcage; chest proud, biceps and lats contracted; ankles crossed.
mechanics: Vertical pulling with supinated grip emphasizing biceps brachii and latissimus dorsi. No kipping or swinging.
avoid: Do not show overhand pronated grip, no kipping legs, no extra limbs, no text/labels/arrows.
checks: Identity and proportions match the original style references
Both poses show the same equipment and geometry
Cuffs and other attachments are visibly connected as specified
Movement, limb count and support positions are plausible
No cropped equipment, logos, text, gradients or muscle activation percentages
Entry remains draft until technique and equipment details are reviewed
